details:
- CVE-2026-105929: Skip, with a warning (an error unless --ignore-errors is given), a role from a requirements file or a role's meta/requirements.yml whose name, joined to each configured roles path, resolves outside of every one of them, before the role is installed.
- CVE-2026-130644: Validate the collection namespace and name read from a collection artifact's MANIFEST.json / galaxy.yml, and the name of a collection requirement entry, as a well-formed <namespace>.<name> before they are used to build the 'ansible-galaxy collection install' destination path.
